subject.title: Feature: Granular Discord action gates (split actions.messages into read/edit/delete)

question: Should Discord expose separate send, read, edit, and delete message permissions, and which single canonical config shape should replace the shipped coarse boolean?
rationale: This changes a public security and configuration contract; repository policy requires explicit approval of the canonical shape, inheritance defaults, and migration rather than permanent runtime compatibility branches.

options.title: Canonical granular gates
options.body: Adopt one granular schema, migrate the existing boolean with doctor, and update discovery and execution together so every action has one permission source.

options.title: Keep the coarse gate
options.body: Retain the existing all-or-nothing message permission and document that destructive message actions cannot be disabled independently.

recommendation.title: Canonical granular gates
recommendation.body: Adopt one granular schema, migrate the existing boolean with doctor, and update discovery and execution together so every action has one permission source.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the prior product review and have the strongest recent merged history across the central Discord messaging runtime.
